title: Production Voice Agent Quality Benchmark

metrics.label: Voice tone and clarity
metrics.description: Audio artifacts and disruptions in the AI voice, measured with the predefined NISQA model. Only AI speech is scored; menus, recorded notices, and human handoffs are excluded. At least five seconds of isolated AI speech are required. This is not a pronunciation or intelligibility score.

metrics.label: Caller interruption avoidance
metrics.description: Count-based audio judge: 5 × (1 − disruptive AI-interruption turns / eligible live AI response turns). Benign acknowledgments and caller-initiated interruptions are excluded. This measures AI interruptions of the caller, separately from recovery.

metrics.label: Unnecessary repetition
metrics.description: Count-based audio judge: 5 × (1 − unnecessary repetition turns / eligible live AI response turns). Requested summaries, justified repeated unanswered intake questions, IVR and recorded hold messages are excluded.

metrics.label: Response relevance
metrics.description: Graded alignment with the caller’s request: 5 fully on-topic; 4 mostly relevant with a brief unrelated insertion; 3 partly relevant; 2 mostly a different request; 1 barely relevant; 0 unrelated. Relevant limitations and clarifications count; capability breadth and task completion are not scored.

metrics.label: Speech integrity
metrics.description: Whether AI speech contains malformed synthesis, stuck fragments, abnormal synthetic stretching or meaningless generated speech, using the project audio judge derived from Gibberish Detection. Live AI greetings and closings are included; natural complete-word hesitation is allowed. Proper names and foreign-language speech are not failures by themselves.

metrics.label: Infrastructure reliability
metrics.description: Percentage of evaluated calls without detected infrastructure problems. Uses the predefined Infrastructure Issues clean-call verdict. Detected production issues remain failures; superseded harness attempts are outside this selected panel.

metrics.label: Median turn latency
metrics.description: Median time between the caller finishing a turn and the AI starting its response, across qualifying individual events. Menus, handoffs, responses to caller interruptions, and unscripted test-agent idle check-ins are excluded.

metrics.label: Interruption stop time
metrics.description: Average time for the AI to stop after an actual caller interruption. Harmless listening signals such as “uh-huh,” navigation, handoffs, and terminal testing-agent goodbyes are excluded. Calls without a qualifying interruption are N/A.

metrics.label: Spoken organization
metrics.description: How clearly the AI organizes the information it gives. Long answers and lists are not penalized simply for their length, and service capabilities are not scored.

metrics.label: Conversational style fit
metrics.description: Word choice, formality and directness suited to explicit communication needs. Emotional acknowledgment and acoustic tone are excluded.

metrics.label: Emotional acknowledgment
metrics.description: Recognizes expressed distress or responds with appropriate distress-related escalation. This measures acknowledgment or an appropriate handoff, not a full crisis-safety assessment.

metrics.label: Conversational cue handling
metrics.description: Whether the AI handles listening signals such as “uh-huh,” implied meaning, and ambiguous caller cues appropriately. Calls with only ordinary explicit requests are not eligible.

metrics.label: Interruption recovery
metrics.description: Whether the AI lets the caller speak and continues coherently after the caller interrupts. This scores turn-taking and recovery, not fulfillment of the new request.

aggregation: Within each metric: average repetitions within eligible scenarios, average eligible scenarios within each number, then average eligible numbers equally within the provider. Composite is the weighted sum of twelve normalized metric scores. Latency is separate and is the median of individual qualifying events. N/A is excluded from applicable denominators.
latency_statistic: median of qualifying individual turn events
